scope: Selected Engineering Foundations and Practice concepts; not a complete course inventory or proof of learner competence.
depth_meaning: Authoring tier for the linked explanation, not a certified mastery level.

jls21.title: Java Language Specification 21, Chapter 17
jls21.scope: Java-specific synchronization and happens-before, not general hardware or persistence semantics.

ostep.title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces, authors' text
ostep.scope: Operating-system mechanisms; no numerical latency claims imported.

sqlite.title: SQLite Atomic Commit
sqlite.scope: Rollback-journal commit and hardware assumptions; not its WAL algorithm or proof of this host's power-loss behavior.

flp.title: Fischer, Lynch, Paterson, Impossibility of Distributed Consensus with One Faulty Process, 1985
flp.scope: Deterministic consensus termination in the stated asynchronous crash model.

lamport.title: Lamport, Time, Clocks, and the Ordering of Events, 1978
lamport.scope: Happened-before and logical clocks; ordered timestamps do not imply causality.

raft.title: Ongaro and Ousterhout, In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm, extended, 2014
raft.scope: Raft election, commitment, and configuration rules; not arbitrary lease or shard protocols.

little.title: Little, A Proof for the Queuing Formula L = lambda W, 1961
little.scope: Long-run average relation under its assumptions, not percentile prediction.

kingman.title: Kingman, The Single Server Queue in Heavy Traffic, 1961
kingman.scope: Queueing approximation, not a benchmark of Atlas.

wrk2.title: wrk2, author's measurement documentation
wrk2.scope: Rate-controlled measurement and coordinated omission; the Python fixtures are not wrk2 benchmarks.

aries.title: Mohan et al., ARIES, 1992
aries.scope: ARIES recovery protocol; not a claim every database implements it.

postgres17.title: PostgreSQL 17, Using EXPLAIN
postgres17.scope: Versioned plan interpretation; ANALYZE executes the statement and cost units are not milliseconds.

temporal.title: Snodgrass, Developing Time-Oriented Database Applications in SQL, 1999
temporal.scope: Temporal axes and intervals; fixture precedence is a local teaching policy.

ieee754.title: IEEE 754-2019
ieee754.scope: Floating-point arithmetic; domain unit and rounding policy is an application decision.

http.title: RFC 9110, HTTP Semantics, June 2022
http.scope: HTTP acceptance, validators, preconditions; custom idempotency and lifecycle policies are not RFC requirements.

protection.title: Saltzer and Schroeder, The Protection of Information in Computer Systems, 1975
protection.scope: Complete mediation and least privilege; not a distributed revocation implementation.

zanzibar.title: Pang et al., Zanzibar, 2019
zanzibar.scope: Primary authorization-system design, not proof that a simple cache has the same guarantees.

privacy.title: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0, 2020
privacy.scope: Privacy risk management, not legal advice or compliance certification.

sre.title: Google SRE Workbook, Implementing SLOs, 2018
sre.scope: SLI and error-budget practice; all Atlas targets and rates are illustrative.

adr.title: Nygard, Documenting Architecture Decisions, 2011
adr.scope: Lightweight decision records; course evidence and retirement gates are local extensions.

evodb.title: Sadalage and Fowler, Evolutionary Database Design
evodb.scope: Incremental database evolution; not a proof of the fixture's authority transfer.

linearizability.title: Herlihy and Wing, Linearizability, 1990
linearizability.scope: Concurrent-history correctness definition; fixtures do not implement a general checker.

tla.title: Lamport, Specifying Systems, 2002
tla.scope: State-machine and temporal reasoning; no formal proof is claimed for Atlas.
